attributes.name: search_control_shape
attributes.definition: Overall shape/styling of the search input field

values.definition: Fully rounded or pill-shaped input field
Input and button joined as a single bar with squared or modest corners
Rounded input within a distinct shadowed container

attributes.name: search_button_placement
attributes.definition: How the submit button is positioned relative to the search input

values.definition: Button attached directly to the input, forming one bar
Button sits beside the input as a distinct element
Button placed inside the input/container boundary

attributes.name: search_container_treatment
attributes.definition: Whether the search sits within a visually distinct container (shadow, card) or stands alone

values.definition: Wrapped in a shadowed or card-like container
Defined by a coloured or visible border on the field itself
No special container or border treatment mentioned

attributes.name: search_alignment
attributes.definition: Horizontal alignment/width of the search control
